objects.title: Dorvian 3rd Combined Arms Army
objects.body: Combined arms force with integrated air defence, EW, and cyber capabilities. Manoeuvre-heavy doctrine with strong ISR and long-range fires. Will challenge BLUFOR across all functional areas simultaneously.

objects.title: Asymmetric threat cells
objects.body: Proxy forces conducting information operations, sabotage of LOCs, and civilian population influence. Active disinformation campaign targeting NATO public opinion and allied cohesion.
